description: On the green-covered table in front are a black tape dispenser, a red string, and several sorted piles of colorful beads, with a partly made blue beaded strand near the hands. The left hand steadies the strand and black cord near the center while the right hand moves to the bead piles on the right, pinches a bead, and brings it back to the cord to thread it on, then briefly returns toward the piles to pick up another bead; the beaded strand is a left-hand object and the loose bead is a right-hand object while being threaded.
